text:
Jack Hughes is the kind of player whose bad luck still looks pretty good. He has 29 points in 23 games for the Devils, playing nearly 21 minutes a night, and the Devils control 61% of the expected goals at five on five with him out there, 7.7 points better than without him. That is a first-line center bending the ice.

The goals have lagged. He has 10 on 12.5 expected, shooting 11.5% when our range for him sits a bit higher. He keeps getting to the net (Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking had him in the 97th percentile for chances from the slot last season), and finishing usually catches up with chances like that. His recent run has been quieter: no goals in his last six games after five in the four before.

Off the ice, he became the first outside investor in Saint James Iced Tea this week. On it, the Olympic hero who won gold for the United States in overtime against Canada has a projection of about 101 points.
headline: Hughes keeps getting the looks, if not the goals
